about_the_game:
Clamor Lycanis – Forest Demo gives you a taste of the full horror experience by immersing you in the forested perimeter of a remote medical institute. This demo covers everything from the moment you cross the fence until you finally unlock the institute’s main doors.

What’s Included in the Demo?

  • Forest Outposts Exploration
    Step into small, concrete research huts scattered among the trees. Each outpost contains keynotes, cryptic messages, and environmental clues that piece together what happened to your missing loved one—a researcher who vanished while studying porphyria.

  • Light-Based Survival
    Your flashlight is both a tool and a weapon. Wolves stalking the woods attack any source of light on command, forcing you to decide when to illuminate paths or risk drawing danger closer.

  • Pepper Spray Defense
    Pick up limited pepper spray canisters to fend off common wolves. Use it strategically—resources are scarce, and every spray could save your life.

  • Narrative Through Notes
    Discover handwritten journals and hastily scrawled messages in each outpost, revealing fragments of the institute’s sinister secrets and the presence known only as “Patient Alpha.”

  • Unlock the Main Entrance
    Collect keycards hidden in several outposts to gradually raise your clearance level, culminating in the final key that opens the institute’s doors. Once inside, the demo ends—teasing the deeper mystery awaiting in the full game.

Why Play the Demo?

  • Experience the tense, immersive atmosphere of Clamor Lycanis firsthand.

  • Witness how light and darkness shape your survival strategy.

  • Get a glimpse of the psychological horror and storytelling style before committing to the full journey.

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains mature topics and may not be appropriate for all audiences.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 or 11
  • Processor: Ryzen 5 7640U
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Radeon 760M
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

short_description: Cross the fence into a forest of abandoned research outposts. In this demo, explore the perimeter of a secluded medical institute, fend off wolves that attack light, gather notes, and unlock the main entrance—before the true horror within begins.
